verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party bulk-export feature that sends traces or datasets to blob storage (such as S3, GCS or Azure) or to a data warehouse (such as BigQuery or Snowflake). The only related evidence is the Weave Service API, which gives programmatic REST access (including /calls/stream_query). That is a developer building block for writing your own export, not the export capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse

citations.quote: Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.
